description: Source code implementing convolution parameters, shape checks, and convolution operations for XPU backend using oneDNN, including functions for forward and backward passes, and registration of operators.

classes.name: ConvParams
classes.description: Structure holding convolution parameters such as stride, padding, dilation, groups, and flags for transposed, benchmark, deterministic. Includes methods for shape checks, parameter analysis, and utility functions.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads stream insertion operator to print ConvParams details.

methods.name: is_strided
methods.description: Checks if stride indicates a strided convolution.

methods.name: is_dilated
methods.description: Checks if dilation indicates a dilated convolution.

methods.name: is_output_padding_neg
methods.description: Checks if any output padding value is negative.

methods.name: is_output_padding_big
methods.description: Checks if output padding exceeds stride or dilation.

methods.name: is_padding_neg
methods.description: Checks if padding values are negative.

methods.name: is_stride_nonpos
methods.description: Checks if stride values are non-positive.

methods.name: view1d_as_2d
methods.description: Converts 1D convolution parameters to 2D by inserting default values.

methods.name: use_cpu_depthwise3x3_winograd
methods.description: Stub function returning false; placeholder for depthwise 3x3 Winograd optimization.

methods.name: is_depthwise
methods.description: Checks if the convolution is depthwise based on input, weight, and group parameters.

methods.name: _convolution_out
methods.description: Performs convolution or transposed convolution, handling shape checks, memory formats, and calling oneDNN primitives.

methods.name: _convolution
methods.description: Wrapper around _convolution_out to produce output tensor.

methods.name: convolution_overrideable
methods.description: Public API for convolution with optional bias, handling parameters and calling internal implementation.

methods.name: convolution_backward_overrideable
methods.description: Computes gradients for input, weight, and bias during backpropagation.

methods.name: convolution_pointwise
methods.description: Performs pointwise convolution with specified attributes and scalars.

methods.name: convolution_pointwise_binary
methods.description: Performs binary pointwise convolution with additional unary attributes.

methods.name: convolution_pointwise_binary_
methods.description: In-place version of binary pointwise convolution.
